scope: real context_views, ReadCache and AgentLabStorage; temporary projects; simulated executor contract; no bridge/continuity/task_control execution

measurement_notes.time: time.perf_counter wall time; milliseconds; local disk/cache work only; no model latency or production speed claim
measurement_notes.chars: Unicode code points of json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False), unless field explicitly names source/output chars
measurement_notes.estimated_tokens: ceil(serialized UTF-8 bytes / 3), minimum 1; heuristic only; no tokenizer, API usage, billing or monetary costs
measurement_notes.baseline: same capped line requests read from disk without cache; cached path includes plan, executor and commit; local cache can cost more wall time while avoiding executor calls
measurement_notes.rounds: scripted requests and synthetic messages, no model-generated decisions; a new ReadCache instance per request tests persistent reuse
measurement_notes.repeat_timing: seven samples including first call, median/min/max; no brittle absolute speed threshold
